, etc.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. ulula; A.S. and O.H.G. ûla.
उलूखल (cf. उदूखल), n. A mortar, Pañc. 249, 8.
-उलूखलिक, i. e. उलूखल + इक, adj. A substitute for the last, when latter part of comp. adj., e. g. दन्त-, adj. One who uses his teeth as a mortar or pestle,
-उलूखलिन्, i. e. उलूखल + इन्, in दन्त-, adj. Using his teeth as a mortar or pestle,
उल्लुञ्चन, i. e. उद्-लुञ्च् + अन, n. Pulling, Yājñ. 2, 217.
